name: gsc-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Google Search Console: sites, Search Analytics with auto-pagination and hourly data, sitemaps, URL inspection and batch inspection.

tools.name: gsc_list_sites
tools.description: List the Search Console properties the service account can read

tools.name: gsc_query_search_analytics
tools.description: Query Search Analytics with filters, auto-pagination and hourly data

tools.name: gsc_list_sitemaps
tools.description: List sitemaps for a property or read one sitemap

tools.name: gsc_batch_inspect_urls
tools.description: Inspect many URLs with client-side throttling

service_account_json.title: Service account JSON
service_account_json.description: Google service-account key file with the webmasters.readonly scope
